phase.title: Composer intelligence
phase.goal: Make the Dr. Stein menu composer behave like an intelligent command surface: predictive slash commands, explainable recommendations, keyboard navigation, and tests for common typo/partial-command gaps.

phase.title: Efficient Training Pipeline
phase.goal: Complete the 3-stage training pipeline (SFT → Reasoning → DPO) with memory-efficient techniques: bfloat16 autocast, gc.collect graph cleanup, gradient checkpointing. Fix the Stage 2 memory leak, re-run reasoning training, run DPO to produce dr_stein.pt.

phase.title: Eval & Continual Improvement
phase.goal: Establish dr_stein baseline, build benchmark battery (HumanEval/MBPP/GSM8K/ARC/HellaSwag/GAD-tool-calls), wire Claude-subagent teacher distillation (haiku-4-5 default — OpenCode descoped 2026-05-05), stand up a training factory that sweeps configs across many small experiments fast.

phase.title: Substrate + Routing
phase.goal: Land the runtime substrate (probes, vLLM serving, rule router, agent corpus extractor) so SLM specialists can be served and routed before any further training. Then train first agent-as-SLM specialists on real GAD agent corpora.

phase.title: Continuous Local Delta Lab
phase.goal: Stand up the gated, candidate-only continuous training loop on the 1660 Ti per decision slm-learning-051. First targets: routers, rerankers, judges, prompt deltas, IA3/BitFit, small candidate adapters. LoRA/TIES merge requires PLAN.md + adapter-composition evals + manual promotion gate. No automatic merge or hot-swap. Output: a queue of candidate adapters per night, each with eval traces and a promotion verdict from Verifier+Critic.

phase.title: SWE-bench Integration
phase.goal: Wire SWE-bench-Lite and SWE-bench-Verified into the eval matrix per decision slm-learning-053. Score every candidate adapter on a fixed SWE-bench slice as part of the promotion gate. Verdent-style coding-agent eval discipline. Includes the harness, the patch evaluator, the result schema, and the routing rule that promotes a SWE-bench-positive adapter for code-edit shapes.
